author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Clone any voice in seconds using a free AI voice generator that runs directly on your PC.

In this step-by-step tutorial, I’ll show you how to create realistic AI voices using a free and open-source app called Voicebox. You’ll learn how to record or upload a voice sample, generate natural-sounding speech, and even create multi-speaker conversations with AI.

No subscriptions. No cloud uploads. Everything runs locally on your computer.

⬇️ Download Voicebox: https://voicebox.sh

⚠️ Note: Only use voices you have permission to use.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Compare real voice vs AI clone
0:23 - Download and install Voicebox
0:43 - Create your first voice
1:53 - Generate AI speech
2:29 - Export audio
2:41 - Upload and clone another voice
3:18 - Create a multi-speaker conversation
4:20 - Additional functionality
5:09 - Improve voice quality tips
5:33 - Wrap up
